after.reason: The baseline representative form is marked sK in the pinned JMdict entry. Prefer an ordinary unmarked spelling, or the verified kana form when all kanji forms are marked. Keep the same lexical entry, selected sense, reading and existing item ID.

curation.json.before: Only the primary existing spelling and display reading are proposed as canonical answers. Unreviewed alternate forms/readings and glosses from other senses are excluded for new sessions. Existing frozen sessions remain unchanged.
curation.json.after: Preferred written form and display reading are verified within the same pinned lexical entry and selected sense. Rare/search-only baseline forms are not taught as the sole normal answer. Other-sense answers remain excluded; existing IDs, ownership and frozen sessions are preserved.
